basic_details.short_information: The written test/interview for the Consultant (Ayurveda) post will be held on 5 November 2026 (Thursday) at 10.30 A.M. at Central Ayurveda Research Institute, Road No.66, Punjabi Bagh (West), New Delhi- 110026. content_sections.heading: About CARI Consultant (Ayurveda)
content_sections.text: Central Ayurveda Research Institute (CARI) is located at Punjabi Bagh (West), Road No. 66, New Delhi - 110026. Its letterhead says it works under the Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences, Ministry of AYUSH, Govt. of India, and shows NABH accreditation. You can contact the institute's office on 011-25221059 or by email at [email protected] and [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Consultant (Ayurveda), with 01 (One) vacancy. It is open to both male and female candidates. The pay is Rs.60,000/- per month consolidated. (i) Post graduation in Ayurveda – MD(Ay)/MS(Ay) from a recognized university OR (i) Graduation in Ayurveda from a recognized university with additional experience of 02 years The notice's post table asks for "Post qualification experience 5-10 years". Knowledge of Computer applications like MS office. The age limit is up to 45 years as on the date of interview. Age eligibility will be determined as on the date of interview. Please check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Original certificates for verification Two passport size photographs Self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates A "No Objection Certificate", only if you are employed elsewhere

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the prescribed qualifications may walk in at the institute address on 5 November 2026. A written test/interview starts at 10.30 A.M. Original certificates will be checked at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates who are not willing to do night duties should not apply. The engagement is initially for six months and is purely on contractual basis. No claim for continuance or regular appointment will be entertained. The Competent Authority may curtail or extend the services at its discretion on need basis, subject to the individual's performance. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the CARI Consultant (Ayurveda) walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The written test/interview will be held on 5 November 2026 (Thursday) at 10.30 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the CARI walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Central Ayurveda Research Institute, Road No.66, Punjabi Bagh (West), New Delhi- 110026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in CARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) vacancy for the post of Consultant (Ayurveda), open to both male and female candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for CARI Consultant (Ayurveda)?
faq.answer: You need a post graduation in Ayurveda (MD(Ay)/MS(Ay)) from a recognized university, OR a graduation in Ayurveda from a recognized university with 02 years of additional experience. The post table also lists 5-10 years of post qualification experience, and knowledge of computer applications like MS office is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the CARI Consultant (Ayurveda) post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 45 years as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a CARI Consultant (Ayurveda)?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.60,000/- per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the CARI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your original certificates for verification, two passport size photographs and self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates. If you are employed elsewhere, you must also bring a "No Objection Certificate".

faq.question: Q8. How will CARI select the Consultant (Ayurveda)?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through a written test/interview at the institute on 5 November 2026 at 10.30 A.M.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CARI Consultant (Ayurveda) job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, initially for six months, and may be curtailed or extended at the Competent Authority's discretion. No claim for continuance or regular appointment will be entertained.

faq.question: Q10. Will CARI pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
